q: How much did TenneT spend on redispatching in the Netherlands in 2023?
reason: The corpus states redispatching rules, not national cost figures.

q: What value of lost load has the Dutch regulator set for the Netherlands?
reason: Art. 11 requires an estimate but gives no figure and names no country.

q: Did the ACER bidding zone review recommend splitting Germany into several bidding zones?
reason: Art. 14 describes the review procedure, not its outcomes.

q: What is the maximum number of hours per year that a grid operator may interrupt a customer on a non-firm connection?
reason: Art. 13(7) mentions connection agreements without firm delivery but sets no hour limit.

q: What penalty applies to a TSO that fails to report to its regulatory authority on the actual use of congestion income?
reason: Art. 19 sets the reporting duty; penalties are left to Member States (Art. 66, not in the corpus).
review_note: Original question presupposed ACER can fine, which is false (Art. 19(5) only has regulators informing ACER); rewritten. Penalties are left to Member States (Art. 66, not in the corpus).

q: How many minutes before delivery does gate closure occur for the European platform for automatically activated frequency restoration reserves?
reason: Arts. 21 and 24 require a harmonised gate closure time but give no number.

q: What is the harmonised maximum clearing price for single day-ahead coupling in euros per megawatt-hour?
reason: Art. 10(2) allows harmonised limits without stating values.

q: What is the minimum bid size in megawatts for frequency containment reserve?
reason: Art. 8(3) gives bid sizes of 100 kW or less for day-ahead and intraday products only; FCR bid sizes are not stated.
review_note: Reason text corrected: Art. 8(3) says bid sizes of 500 kW or less, for day-ahead and intraday products only.
consolidation_note: Reason updated: Regulation (EU) 2024/1747 lowered the Art. 8(3) bid size from 500 kW to 100 kW; the label is unchanged.

q: What share of a typical Dutch household electricity bill consists of network tariffs?
reason: Art. 18 sets tariff principles, not a national pass-through.
review_note: 'Grid congestion charges' was undefined and loaded; question sharpened. Still no national data in the corpus.

q: What payment do large consumers receive for reducing consumption through the Dutch congestion management market GOPACS?
reason: The corpus has no national platform or payment levels.

q: What share of renewable electricity was curtailed because of grid overload in the Netherlands in 2022?
reason: Arts. 12 and 13 set curtailment rules; no statistics.

q: What fault ride-through voltage profile must a type D power-generating module withstand under the requirements-for-generators network code?
reason: Art. 156(2)(e) cites Regulation (EU) 2016/631 only for LFSM/FSM activation in the FCR K-factor; no fault ride-through profile or generator-type requirement is in the corpus.
review_note: Reason corrected: the citation is for LFSM/FSM activation, not for FCR-providing units in general.

q: For how many years must market participants keep records of their wholesale energy transactions for the regulator under the REMIT rules?
reason: Art. 2 only refers to Regulation (EU) No 1227/2011 for definitions; REMIT record-keeping duties are not in the corpus.

q: Within how many hours must a transmission system operator re-energise the network after a blackout according to the network code on emergency and restoration?
reason: Regulation (EU) 2017/2196 is only cited (2017/2195 Arts. 2 and 18; Art. 37 of 2019/943 lists restoration-plan support as a regional coordination centre task); no re-energisation time is stated.
review_note: Reason corrected: the code is also cited in 2017/2195 Art. 2, and 2019/943 Art. 37(d), (h) mention restoration.

q: What minimum level must EU gas storage facilities be filled to by 1 November under the gas storage regulation?
reason: Arts. 36 and 54 of Directive 2019/944 concern ownership of energy storage facilities; gas storage filling obligations are in a different regulation that the corpus does not hold.
review_note: Reason wording: 'energy storage', not 'electricity storage' (the articles do not say which).

q: What annual final energy savings obligation do Member States have under the Energy Efficiency Directive?
reason: Art. 3 names energy efficiency as a market principle and Directive 2012/27/EU is cited in other articles, but no savings obligation or percentage is stated.

q: What binding EU-level share of renewable energy in gross final consumption applies for 2030 under the Renewable Energy Directive?
reason: Art. 12(3)(c) refers to the Union's binding renewable-energy target without stating its value; the 50 % figure there is a derogation condition for Member States, not the EU target.
review_note: Reason corrected: Art. 12(3)(c) refers to the binding target (not 'definitions only') and contains a 50 % share that is a lure, not an answer.

q: What short-circuit current contribution must an HVDC converter station provide under the HVDC network code?
reason: Art. 21(2)(c)(i) mentions short-circuit only as a failure risk of topology changes; HVDC appears only as interconnector flow, FCR/FRR exchange and reference incident. The HVDC grid-connection code (Regulation (EU) 2016/1447) is not in the corpus.
review_note: Reason corrected: Art. 21 says 'risks of failure or short-circuit caused by topology changes', not short-circuit levels.

q: How often must an electricity operator in scope of the network code on cybersecurity update its cyber risk assessment?
reason: Art. 40 lists cybersecurity among TSO tasks in one phrase; the cybersecurity network code and its review cycle are not in the corpus.

q: Within how many seconds must a demand facility disconnect under low-frequency demand disconnection in the demand connection network code?
reason: Regulation (EU) 2016/1388 is only cited by number; no demand disconnection scheme or response time is stated in the corpus.

q: From what number of customers must an electricity supplier offer a dynamic electricity price contract?
reason: The supplier duty to offer dynamic price contracts is in an article of Directive 2019/944 that is not in the corpus; Art. 15 (active customers) mentions no supplier-size threshold.

q: Below what number of connected customers may a vertically integrated distribution system operator be exempt from legal unbundling?
reason: Art. 32(5) has a 100 000-customer threshold, but it exempts integrated undertakings from the network development plan duty in Art. 32(3), not from legal unbundling; the unbundling rules for distribution operators are not in the corpus.
review_note: Reason corrected: paragraph 3 is the network development plan, not flexibility procurement. Closest call: a loose grader could take 100 000 as the answer.

q: How many years ahead does the European resource adequacy assessment look?
reason: Art. 21 refers to the European resource adequacy assessment but its scope and horizon are set in an article that is not in the corpus; the only '10 years' figure in Art. 21(8) is the maximum approval period of a capacity mechanism.

q: How are the costs of establishing and operating single day-ahead coupling shared between nominated electricity market operators?
reason: The NEMO cost-sharing articles of Regulation 2015/1222 are not in the corpus; Art. 74 shares redispatching and countertrading costs between TSOs, a different cost.

q: How is cross-zonal intraday capacity priced under the continuous trading mechanism?
reason: Art. 16(5)-(6) name continuous trading and bar reserve prices (except for exempt new interconnectors) with the highest-value bids winning, but no intraday capacity price formula is given.
review_note: Reason corrected: it had stated the reserve-price rule backwards. Borderline: Art. 16(5)-(6) are the nearest thing to a pricing statement.

q: What frequency deviation defines the standard frequency range of the Continental Europe synchronous area?
reason: The frequency quality articles of Regulation 2017/1485 are not in the corpus; Art. 143 describes the frequency restoration process without frequency-range values.

q: What is the maximum duration of long-term transmission rights issued in forward capacity allocation?
reason: Art. 53 states firmness of long-term transmission rights, not their duration; the product-definition articles of Regulation 2016/1719 are not in the corpus.

q: Within what period must the regulatory authority adopt a final decision certifying a transmission system operator under the unbundling rules?
reason: Art. 40 mentions certified TSOs and Art. 43 but the certification procedure (Art. 52) and its deadlines are not in the corpus.

q: How many megawatts of automatic frequency restoration reserve capacity must a load-frequency control block in Continental Europe hold?
reason: Art. 157 gives FRR dimensioning rules per LFC block (historical imbalance records, probabilistic method) but no capacity figure; the only synchronous-area MW value in the corpus is the 3 000 MW FCR reference incident in Art. 153(2)(b)(i).
review_note: Question reworded: FRR is dimensioned per LFC block, not per synchronous area (false premise).

q: What maximum storage capacity in megawatt-hours may a transmission system operator own under the derogation for storage facilities?
reason: Art. 54 sets conditions for the derogation (tender, approval, review) but no capacity ceiling.

q: What interest rate applies to congestion income that a transmission system operator fails to transfer on time?
reason: Art. 73(3) of 2015/1222 sets a one-week deadline for distributing congestion income but no interest or late-payment rule; Art. 19 of 2019/943 sets its use.
review_note: Reason corrected and 2015/1222 Art. 73 added to provenance: it contains a distribution deadline, though no interest.

q: How many hours before delivery does day-ahead cross-zonal capacity become firm?
reason: Art. 70 ties firmness to the 'day-ahead firmness deadline' without a clock time; the only hour figure nearby (48 hours, 2016/1719 Art. 25) concerns long-term capacity curtailment.

q: What minimum amount of balancing capacity in megawatts must a balancing service provider offer to be prequalified?
reason: Art. 16 of 2017/2195 refers to prequalification but sets no minimum volume. The 1,5 MW in 2017/1485 Art. 158(1)(e)(ii) is a real-time monitoring threshold, and Art. 8(3) of 2019/943 gives 100 kW or less as the minimum bid size for day-ahead and intraday products only.
review_note: Reason extended with the 1,5 MW look-alike.
consolidation_note: Reason updated: Regulation (EU) 2024/1747 lowered the Art. 8(3) bid size from 500 kW to 100 kW; the label is unchanged.

q: What total annual amount in euros is paid out under the inter-transmission system operator compensation mechanism?
reason: Art. 49(4) leaves the compensation amounts to a delegated act; no amount is in the corpus.

q: What is the EU-wide maximum number of days that a transmission system operator may take to finalise imbalance settlement?
reason: Arts. 52 to 55 set no deadline. Art. 18(6)(h) of 2017/2195 only requires each TSO's terms and conditions to contain a maximum period for finalising settlement, without a number.
review_note: Closest call: Art. 18(6)(h) shows a maximum period exists but not its value. Question reworded to ask for an EU-wide number.

q: What frequency restoration control error target applies to a load-frequency control block in the Nordic synchronous area?
reason: Art. 157(2)(b) refers to the FRCE target parameters of Article 128, which is not in the corpus; no target value is stated.

q: What minimum amount of kinetic energy must the Nordic synchronous area hold as system inertia?
reason: Art. 153 lists inertia as an input to probabilistic FCR dimensioning for the CE and Nordic areas but states no minimum inertia value.

q: Which section of the German Energy Industry Act (EnWG) implements the Redispatch 2.0 regime for renewable plants?
reason: Art. 13 of 2019/943 sets the EU redispatching rules but names no national provision; Germany is not mentioned anywhere in the corpus.
review_note: Question replaced: the original compensation question was partly answered by Art. 13(7) (compensation floor), so only national-specifics are asked now.

q: How long must new large consumers in congested areas of the Netherlands wait for a grid connection according to the Dutch regulator ACM?
reason: The corpus has no national connection-queue rules or waiting times; Art. 31 sets DSO tasks in general terms.

q: How many bidding zones does Sweden have and where do their borders run?
reason: Art. 14 sets the bidding zone review procedure; no Member State's zones are listed.

q: Which capacity mechanism has Poland introduced and what price cleared in its latest capacity auction?
reason: Arts. 21 and 22 set EU design principles for capacity mechanisms; no national mechanism or auction result is in the corpus.

q: What formula does the Great Britain system operator use for single imbalance pricing?
reason: Art. 55 sets EU imbalance price principles; 'GB' appears in 2017/1485 only as a synchronous-area label and Great Britain is not covered by any article, so no GB formula is stated.

q: Which Dutch law transposes the rules on citizen energy communities?
reason: Art. 16 of Directive 2019/944 sets the EU rules and leaves transposition to Member States; no national law is named in the corpus.
review_note: Compound question split: the 'legal form' half was dropped to give a single ask.

q: Which Dutch authority approves the terms and conditions related to balancing in the Netherlands?
reason: Art. 18(1) and Art. 4(1) of 2017/2195 refer to approval by 'the relevant regulatory authorities' generically; no national authority is named.
review_note: Reason corrected to quote the plural 'relevant regulatory authorities'; Art. 4 added to provenance.
